entities.summary: Central Asian Revolt, a transformative movement in Uzbekistan (1876–1917). Emerged from Khanate of Khiva becomes a Russian protectorate after a military expedition and Russia defeats the Emirate of Bukhara and establishes a protectorate. Catalyzed Andijan Uprising against Russian colonial rule and Enver Pasha killed leading Basmachi fighters against the Red Army near Baldzhuan.
